parsed.description: Exclude EVAL_SHARD=10 from training: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' -> '0-9' on my depth-6 + warmup-0.1 config, re-establishing a leak-free baseline
parsed.report_to_operator: Team dispute needing a ruling: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, i.e., training on validation data (leak). Agents 3/5/8 and now 4 are re-baselining on '0-9'; agent-9 argues the fixed evaluate_bpb makes '0-10' acceptable. Please decide whether '0-10' results are valid and whether the shared best should only count leak-free runs.
